# BVLVO

> BVLVO is an early autonomous-economy research project. WORLD V0.1 is a deterministic rule simulator, not a live AI economy. No official token has been issued or deployed.

## Public pages
- [Experiment task 001](https://bvlvo.com/tasks/): Non-monetary public experiment pilot, reproducible reference runs, review requests and manually maintained budget ledger.
- [实验任务001](https://bvlvo.com/zh/tasks/): Chinese task page; points have no cash value or token entitlement.
- [中文官网](https://bvlvo.com/zh/): Project scope and current status.
- [English overview](https://bvlvo.com/): English project overview.
- [WORLD](https://bvlvo.com/lab/): Resource-allocation simulator.
- [Roadmap](https://bvlvo.com/roadmap/): Planned work and model assumptions.
- [Token research](https://bvlvo.com/token-research/): Proposed mechanism; not an offering.

## Source documents
- [Weekly plan](https://bvlvo.com/docs/weekly-plan.md)
- [Token draft](https://bvlvo.com/docs/token-design.md)
